text_block_list.text:
Having finished some work and feeling 
hungry, I headed over to the shopping 
district to grab a bite.

Before long, I decided to step into a 
ramen shop tucked quietly away in a back 
alley, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, step right up! Welcome, 
welcome!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Trainer! Done with work? Good job out 
there!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Truth is, the ramen chef blood sleepin' 
inside me suddenly decided to wake up, 
y'see..."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"I just couldn't rest easy unless I made 
ramen, so I asked them to let me work a 
part-time shift."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you can keep eating your menma. Just 
hear me out... on a little story from the 
past.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —That happened on a cold, cold winter day.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
To support my family's screw factory, I 
used to sell metal bats on the street when 
I was a kid.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
“It was so freezing cold that my whole 
body completely froze stiff...”

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
There was nothing I could do, so I just 
sat there sobbing all alone.

Holding back the urge to ask, "What kind 
of setup even is that...?", I listened to 
Gold Ship's story.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"It was right around then—that an 
Umamusume appeared and changed my destiny 
forever."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. From what I could see, she was an 
Umamusume a few years older than me.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All of a sudden, they handed me a bowl 
filled with piping-hot ramen soup.

...I started to get a little confused. 
However, Gold Ship continued to speak with 
a serious expression.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Once my body had warmed up, I thanked her. 
Then, with a wistful look on her face, she 
said this.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"‘I may be an Umamusume, but running isn't 
really my strong suit.’"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"So I'm thinking of opening a ramen shop. 
You should feel free to choose your own 
future, too," they said.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"That was a huge shock to me back then... 
It was the first time anyone had ever told 
me I could do whatever I wanted."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I realized that I didn't necessarily have 
to take over my family's screw factory, 
and that it was okay to do what I wanted.

Why is it... this is starting to sound 
like a heartwarming story.

Refusing to be defined by her birth, and 
forging her own future... How truly 
inspiring and strong she is.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Heheh, my bad for talking your ear off.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Still, bringing up a memory like that 
really makes you want to cook up a bowl of 
ramen, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what that Umamusume is up to now. 
I'd love to see her again, but I don't 
have any leads...
choice_data_list:
Why not try recreating the soup from back 
then?

Why don't you try going back to that 
place?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"That soup from back then...? Can I 
really... make it...?"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"No, but I've grown too. I should be able 
to make it now...!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's give it a shot! If I 
remember right, it had an insane amount of 
garlic in it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Alright... done!

I've created a ramen with extra garlic all 
around—or rather, a ramen that's pretty 
much just pure garlic!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hell yeah, this is the stuff...! This 
smell of garlic that punches your nose 
right in the face—man, I missed it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Here, you eat too. Ready? Let's dig in— 
Thanks for the food—!

And so, we ended up eating the finished 
ramen, but—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —Agabahh!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"WHAT THE HECK IS THIIIIIS?!!!! IT'S SO 
DAMN SPICY――――――!!!!"

The garlic was way too strong, there was 
no way anyone could eat that...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, garlic promotes blood 
circulation... It warms up your body...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I guess I was only able to drink it back 
then because I was freezing... Not 
something you should chug in your right 
mind... —*Gah*!

I couldn't get any hints about that 
Umamusume, but I got to savor those 
nostalgic flavors to my heart's content...

Just when I was starting to forget about 
that incident, one day—something a little 
strange happened.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The riverbed from back then, huh... Yeah, 
let's head over and take a look.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What the heck, nobody's here? Well, makes 
sense, I guess... It is night, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Guess I got no choice. Guess I'll give up 
and head home for today... Hm?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
—Whooooaa!! Suzuka!? Is that really 
Suzuka?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huh? Yes, that's right, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa!! Suzuka, don't 
tell me... That Umamusume from back then 
was you!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Wh-what are you talking about...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now that we know that, we can't just leave 
it be! I'm gonna catch 'em aaalll!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Eeeh!? What is with this~~!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wait, wait, waaaaaaait a secoooond!! Let's 
sit down and reminisce like old pals, 
babyyy!!

According to the story earlier, that 
Umamusume was supposedly a few years older 
than them.

"Even if such a being existed, it wouldn't 
be Silence Suzuka..."

Just when I was starting to forget about 
that incident, one day—something a little 
strange happened.

Mixed in with the fan letters was one 
letter that caught my attention. Its 
contents were...

"Looks like you've been living life just 
the way you want since then. I'll keep 
watching over the way you live so freely."

...There was no name written on it; that 
was all.

Could it be... that the Umamusume who 
taught Gold Ship true freedom actually 
existed...?
